superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu mapu krajnjih vrednosti čestica: zabeleženi minimumi su na stanicama Krnjača i Vračar Dom zdravlja, a oba maksimuma na stanici Obrenovac Centar. Ne mogu da smatram tu mapu sadašnjim stanjem grada: poslednji zvanični prijem je bio pre 138 min, dok je prijem sa građanskih senzora bio pre 13 min, a sama svežina prijema ne potvrđuje slaganje. [F4][F8][F2][F10]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector's particulate endpoint map: the recorded minima are at Krnjača and Vračar Dom zdravlja, with both maxima at Obrenovac Centar [F4][F8]. I cannot treat that map as the city's present condition: official reception is 138 min old, while citizen-sensor reception is 13 min old, and reception freshness alone does not establish agreement [F2][F10].
